pick.headline: FMLN launches 'final offensive' in El Salvador
pick.summary: On 10 January 1981 the FMLN guerrillas launched what they called a final offensive against the Salvadoran government, days before Ronald Reagan took office.
pick.significance: The offensive failed to topple the government but began a decade of full-scale civil war. It led the outgoing Carter administration to resume military aid and made El Salvador a central front of Reagan's Central America policy.
